title: The Strange Certainty of Forever
seoTitle: The Strange Certainty of Forever | Faraz Ansari
description: A philosophical reflection on marriage, love, loneliness, memory and social expectations, asking what it means to promise another person forever.
deck: On marriage, the reasons we give, and the lives we promise without knowing what they will become.
heroAlt: Two empty wooden chairs beside a tall window, facing slightly different directions in soft evening light, representing companionship and an uncertain future.
heroCaption: Sharing a future does not mean knowing what it will become.
